summary:
Public budgeting operations shared by interfaces. Money is integer minor units; revision and request ID are required for mutations. Query results are wrapped in budgetId/revision/data.

Reviewed transactions require a valid category. No category means uncategorized and non-reviewed. Assigning a category alone never marks reviewed; clearing it also clears review. Explicit reviewed=true without a category rejects the entire operation before mutation. Transfer and Income are protected system categories with stable currency-scoped IDs (whab-system:transfer:USD and whab-system:income:USD), canonical systemKind metadata and target zero; they are selectable transaction classifications, not assignable expense envelopes. User categories with the same display names keep their own identities; ambiguous names require an exact ID or full path. Amount signs alone never classify Income. Imported clearing and category-agent labels do not establish a human reviewer's identity.

type.description: Financial account type, independent of budget scope: depository = cash/checking/savings; credit = credit card/line of credit; investment = brokerage; retirement = retirement; property = property; loan = loan; deposit = CD/term deposit; other_asset/other_liability = other tracking asset/debt; other = generic unclassified account, not a credit-card classification. Credit, loan and other_liability are liabilities with a positive amount owed.

balance.description: Current integer-minor-unit balance; null when unknown. Assets carry signed value; liabilities carry a positive amount owed. Classifying an imported account does not verify its balance estimate or fetch a fresh bank balance.

source.description: Record origin, such as ynab, plaid or manual; this is separate from the financial type and onBudget classification.

stale.description: Whether the account snapshot is stale.

onBudget.description: True includes the account in monthly envelope funding/activity; false keeps it for tracking outside envelopes. Only depository and credit may be on budget. New cash/credit accounts default on budget; other types default off budget. An on-budget credit card still represents debt. Existing accounts retain their budget scope when changed to cash/credit unless onBudget is supplied explicitly. Unclassified imports may begin as other, off budget; inspect their saved values before editing.

subtype.description: Domain-specific detail or null. A certificate of deposit is type=deposit, subtype=cd, always off budget; other type/subtype combinations use the domain inventory.

closed.description: True for an archived account, independent of onBudget. Compatible older records default false. Closing does not zero/verify balances, settle debt or rewrite historical financial treatment.

operations.name: preview_bulk_edits
operations.summary:
Read-only core validation and complete exact before/after plan for one atomic batch.

Reviewed transactions require a valid category. No category means uncategorized and non-reviewed. Assigning a category alone never marks reviewed; clearing it also clears review. Explicit reviewed=true without a category rejects the entire operation before mutation. Transfer and Income are protected system categories with stable currency-scoped IDs (whab-system:transfer:USD and whab-system:income:USD), canonical systemKind metadata and target zero; they are selectable transaction classifications, not assignable expense envelopes. User categories with the same display names keep their own identities; ambiguous names require an exact ID or full path. Amount signs alone never classify Income. Imported clearing and category-agent labels do not establish a human reviewer's identity.
